feeds.title: Anglican Compass
feeds.description: The goal of Anglican Compass is to explain Anglican experience, and provide the Anglican Compass perspective on worship, faith, and life. Writers for this site are active Anglican priests, and the focus and scope of the material is based on experience in the parish.

feeds.title: The Anglican Church in North America
feeds.description: Get the latest news and updates from Anglican churches in North America. First and foremost, Anglicans are Christians. Globally, Anglicans form the third largest body of Christians in the world (around 80 million members) behind the Roman Catholic and Eastern Orthodox churches.

feeds.title: High Anglican Haligonian Blog
feeds.description: The personal writings of a liberal Anglo-Catholic living in Halifax. I am a liberal Anglo-Catholic (High Church Anglican) living in Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada. I was raised Methodist, attended a United Church in my teens, but stopped attending church regularly during university, and fell into agnosticism.

feeds.title: Anglican Catholic Liturgy and Theology
feeds.description: Anglican Catholic Liturgy and Theology is a miscellany of writings on Anglican liturgy, Church history, the Anglican Catholic Church, and related matters. Mark David Haverland is the author of Anglican Catholic Faith And Practice, an introduction to orthodox Anglican belief, which is available from the Anglican Parishes Association book publisher.

feeds.title: The Anglocatholic Church
feeds.description: Get the latest news and updates along with sermons from the Anglo-catholic Church of Estonia.

feeds.title: St. Michael's Archangel Anglican Church Blog
feeds.description: Explore our blog for the sermons and musings. St. Michael the Archangel Anglican Church (St. Michael's Anglican Church) in Matthews, NC, a small parish of the Anglican Province of America (APA), is home for those who wish to worship within the beauty and reverence of the traditional Anglican liturgical worship.

feeds.title: Anglican Catholic Church
feeds.description: Get the latest news and updates from ours and other anglo-catholic churches. The Anglican Catholic Church is the original 'continuing' Anglican Church. Since 1992 we have offered an alternative to the Church of England in the UK for Orthodox Catholic Anglicans.

feeds.title: The Amish Catholic » Anglo-Catholic
feeds.description: Explore my thoughts on anglo-catholic christianity. This blog is a distilled personal view of life, art, pop culture, religion, and more. I hope that I can entertain and, perhaps, enlighten people. I'm descended from Pennsylvania's Amish community, including the first Amish bishop in America. But I converted to Catholicism a few years ago, and intend to make the study of Catholic theology my life's work. I came up with the phrase 'Amish Catholic' a few years ago in jest.

feeds.title: Kiwianglo's Blog
feeds.description: Being a retired (though active) priest in the Anglican Church of Aotearoa/New Zealand, and an advocate of justice toward the LBGT community in the Church and the world at large, my interest in entering the WWW. landscape at this juncture is to do what I can to further the cause of inclusivity for a class of persons who have hitherto been either vilified or kept in the background of the Church - despite the fact of their differences in sexuality being intrinsic and God-given.

feeds.title: The Hour Magazine Blog
feeds.description: The Hour Magazine hopes to encourage people to deepen their familiarity with neglected historical Anglican sources in order to take up their project. They left an abundance of resources for socialist political action and parish ministry alike, neither of which are exhausted. The Hour is a quarterly online magazine of criticism that was founded to pick up where the Anglo-Catholic socialist tradition left off.

feeds.title: Africana Anglo-Catholic
feeds.description: Explore the Sermons, Homilies, and Musings of Jae Kirkland Rice. Jae Kirkland Rice is a postulant in the Episcopal Diocese of Rhode Island and a Ph.D. Candidate in the Department of Comparative Literature at Yale University.

feeds.title: Anglo-Empress Blog
feeds.description: I am just a gal in Missouri who loves the Lord Jesus Christ and wants to share the love of God with others. Follow my journey as an Anglo-Catholic disabled.

feeds.title: Anglican Mainstream
feeds.description: This is An information resource for orthodox Anglicans. Anglican Mainstream began in 2004 as part of a united international response of Anglicans from different backgrounds (Reformed, Charismatic and Catholic) to re-state and support traditional understandings of marriage, the family and human sexuality in the face of erosion of these values in church and society.
